# Docker

We use Docker containers to build and run the TMA server. The Dockerfile is located in the root of the repository.

We use the internal [Github Docker Images](https://thehub.github.com/epd/engineering/dev-practicals/containers/container-development/standard-base-image-mechanics/) for our base images.

## Local GitHub Docker Images

If needed, you can pull the GitHub Base images locally using [these docs](https://thehub.github.com/epd/engineering/dev-practicals/containers/container-development/adopt-base-images-for-service/#personal-machine).
